item.title: github: GitHub package firewall in public preview
item.description:
GitHub package firewall is now in public preview. It is intended to reduce malware risks during package installation by blocking package-install-time attacks that can steal credentials from CI/CD hosts or developer workstations.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Code coverage uploads no longer fail CI for new branches
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality’s upload-code-coverage action no longer causes CI failures when coverage is uploaded from a branch that does not yet have an open pull request. This changes behavior from the previous failure case for new branches.

  • Source: GitHub
